headline: Cold drink can boosts iPhone 18 Pro benchmark scores
summary: An enthusiast cooled an iPhone 18 Pro with a cold can of La Croix sparkling water during a prolonged benchmarking session, and the phone showed up to 25% higher sustained performance, illustrating the effect of extra cooling on thermal throttling.

claims.statement: An enthusiast, Matt Birchler, cooled an iPhone 18 Pro with a cold drink can during a benchmarking session.

sources.quote: iPhone 18 Pro benchmark boosted by giving it a cold drink
Matt Birchler put a cold drink can on the back of an iPhone 18 Pro to see how much performance uplift it would get in a prolonged benchmarking session

claims.statement: The cold-can cooling improved the phone's sustained benchmark performance.
